title: ギセイヒーロー
description:
*This game is a free game made by a general individual living in Japan. 

This is the of the Steam Early Access release. The free version includes content up to <Chapter 1>.

*Thank you so much for the requests for an English version! However, the creator lacks the necessary translation skills. Unofficial translation patches are welcome, but since dialogue changes are expected, I highly recommend waiting until the final version is completed before creating them. I am currently developing the paid version. While there will be no major changes to the main scenario, some events will be replaced. Due to freezing issues caused by game updates, a separate store page might be created for the paid version. Additionally, once the release of the paid version is finalized, this store page will be removed.

❖ Synopsis "Perfect Justice Academy" — a prestigious school attended only by "Righteous Students" possessing hearts of justice. The 18 new students of this academy... find themselves forced to participate in the "Absolute Justice Program" within a mysterious enclosed space. The content of this program, which left everyone speechless, is... To expose the 6 "Evil Students" hidden among the 18. Because the goal of the Evil Students is to massacre the Righteous Students, the only way to expose them is... to identify the culprit after a murder occurs. The Righteous Students are forced to make sacrifices in order to flush out the Evil Students...

❖ Overview Genre: Death Game / Mystery / Adventure Playtime: Approx. 3-5 hours (For the free version up to Chapter 1) Development Tool: TyranoBuilder ―――――――――――――――― [Highly Welcomed!] *No permission or reporting required.

• All forms of fan works (No restrictions on expression)

• Let's Plays and streaming (and other video content)

• Reviews, introductions, and theory-crafting

• Use of official illustrations and game screen captures (*Excluding ending illustrations)

• Spoilers are allowed as long as consideration is given, such as using spoiler warnings. *Please refrain from using thumbnails that reveal victims or culprits. If posting major spoilers on social media, please be considerate and use spoiler tags or warnings in advance. ――――――――――――――――

This is a free game independently developed by meʟ. Credits for collaborators and providers of royalty-free materials are listed on the staff page within the game. If you find any bugs, typos, oversights, inconsistencies, or have any questions, I would greatly appreciate it if you could send them via the feedback form. Also, since I am a beginner, there might be inadequacies in the "System Requirements" on this page. If you notice any errors, please kindly let me know.

Please check my Twitter for updates on development progress.
description_short: Among the 18 people who have a heart of justice, there is an evil that seeks murder. It is a mysterious and malicious death game of justice ADV. This is a free game made by an individual. Please note that this is an unfinished work.
